public_api.summary: Create or load a project workspace that owns simulations and jobs.
Load a supported saved FrequenSolve object by its serialized schema.
Represent the simulation that combines physics, model, mesh, boundaries, acquisition, and numerics.
Author stratigraphic surfaces, layers, material properties, and optional boreholes.
Assign one or more boundary conditions to named generated-mesh boundaries.
Configure the supported structured hexahedral mesh generator and adaptivity inputs.
Combine current source geometry, optional source encoding, receivers, and surveys.
Represent one physical point source in inline acquisition geometry.
Describe physical source points using inline, HDF5, or SPS representations.
Map physical source points into named, JSON-dense, or HDF5-dense solver source fields.
Define a point-receiver device and the physical components it records.
Select an explicit subset of source, receiver, and component trace combinations.
Configure public discretization fields while mesh polynomial order remains mesh-owned.
Configure supported solver convergence, precision, and solve-on settings.
Load and inspect supported saved jobs without assuming a removed SimulationJob API.
Create a job for one or more explicit positive modeled frequencies.
Create a time-domain job from a valid uniform frequency sweep and damping settings.
Collect trace, ParaView, wavefield, and related output requests for a job.
Request ParaView-compatible VTK output for a domain, model surface, or explicit grid.
Request wavefield samples on an explicit output grid.
Hold structured errors and warnings returned by package validation.
Validate a simulation with real package rules before export or submission.
Validate a job and its simulation with real package rules before export or submission.
Load this installed package's validated simulation knowledge and exact version identities.

glossary.definition: The packaged, version-matched, offline source of public setup rules, API symbols, glossary terms, diagnostics, examples, and starter scenarios.
A saved workspace containing simulations, jobs, and generated solver inputs or outputs.
A model definition that combines physics, geometry, materials, mesh, boundaries, acquisition, and numerics before it becomes a job.
The authored geometry and material-property description used to build the computational domain.
The discretized computational domain on which the solver evaluates the selected physics.
A physical or numerical condition assigned to one or more named boundaries of the generated mesh.
The source geometry, optional source encoding, receiver groups, and survey selections used by a simulation.
The physical source-point catalog exported in fs-acquisition-2, distinct from the solver source fields derived from those points.
An optional mapping from physical source points into addressable solver source fields.
One addressable solver right-hand side; without explicit encoding, each physical source point is one identity field.
A non-empty real or integer coefficient dataset shaped as encoded fields by physical sources by a final two-value real/imaginary axis; native complex storage and two-dimensional matrices are invalid.
A named collection of receiver coordinates that share one receiver device and its recorded components.
The public numerical settings separate from mesh-owned polynomial order and contract-dependent solver details.
The supported convergence, precision, and solve-on choices attached to a simulation.
A runnable solver request created from a simulation, selected frequencies or time sweep, and requested outputs.
A solver workflow that computes responses at explicitly selected modeled frequencies.
A solver workflow represented by a valid uniform frequency sweep whose responses are transformed into time.
Job configuration that asks the solver to write traces, ParaView files, wavefields, or another supported result.
A solver output written in a ParaView-compatible VTK-family representation for a domain, surface, or grid.
A case-insensitive ParaView reference to top, an authored or expanded horizon name, or a one-based surface_N alias; synthetic bottom and borehole names are not valid selectors.

A missing absolute path outside the resolved local project that may be solver-visible under Slurm or explicit opt-in; it produces a sanitized warning, while relative or project-local missing files remain errors and existing external files are validated locally.
The versioned JSON and HDF5 structures exported by FrequenSolve and consumed by the separately owned solver.
A structured collection of stable errors and warnings produced by package validation.

physics.summary: Scalar pressure-wave propagation in acoustic materials.
Elastic wave propagation with velocity and stress fields.
Coupled material-domain propagation using the public elastic component surface.
Coupled acoustic, elastic, and poroelastic propagation.
Axisymmetric coupled acoustic and elastic propagation.
Poroelastic propagation coupling the solid frame and pore fluid.
Electromagnetic propagation with electric and magnetic fields.

validation_codes.explanation: A receiver coordinate file reference does not identify a regular file.
validation_codes.remediation: Point the receiver group at a readable coordinate file rather than a directory or other filesystem object.

validation_codes.explanation: The configured source-geometry HDF5 file does not exist locally.
validation_codes.remediation: Create or copy the HDF5 file, correct the path, or use the explicit remote-file policy for an intended target-site path.

validation_codes.explanation: The source-geometry HDF5 reference does not identify a regular file.
validation_codes.remediation: Point source_geometry.file at a readable HDF5 file rather than a directory or other filesystem object.

validation_codes.explanation: The source-geometry file exists but cannot be read as HDF5.
validation_codes.remediation: Provide a valid, readable HDF5 file.

validation_codes.explanation: The configured SPS source file does not exist locally.
validation_codes.remediation: Create or copy the SPS file, correct the path, or use the explicit remote-file policy for an intended target-site path.

validation_codes.explanation: The SPS source reference does not identify a regular file.
validation_codes.remediation: Point source_geometry.source_file at a readable SPS file rather than a directory or other filesystem object.

validation_codes.explanation: The selected source-coordinate dataset does not exist in the HDF5 file.
validation_codes.remediation: Choose an existing coordinate dataset.

validation_codes.explanation: The source-coordinate dataset is not a non-empty two-dimensional array.
validation_codes.remediation: Use shape (source_count, coordinate_dimension).

validation_codes.explanation: The source-coordinate dataset is not stored as readable integer or floating-point values.
validation_codes.remediation: Store source coordinates in a readable numeric HDF5 dataset.

validation_codes.explanation: The source-coordinate dataset contains a NaN or infinite value.
validation_codes.remediation: Replace every non-finite coordinate with a finite value.

validation_codes.explanation: The source-coordinate dataset width does not match the simulation dimension.
validation_codes.remediation: Store one coordinate column for each simulation dimension.

validation_codes.explanation: The declared source count differs from the number of rows in the source-coordinate dataset.
validation_codes.remediation: Set count to the dataset row count or omit count.

validation_codes.explanation: The configured source-encoding HDF5 file does not exist locally.
validation_codes.remediation: Create or copy the HDF5 file, correct the path, or use the explicit remote-file policy for an intended target-site path.

validation_codes.explanation: The source-encoding HDF5 reference does not identify a regular file.
validation_codes.remediation: Point source_encoding.file at a readable HDF5 file rather than a directory or other filesystem object.

validation_codes.explanation: The source-encoding file exists but cannot be read as HDF5.
validation_codes.remediation: Provide a valid, readable HDF5 file.

validation_codes.explanation: The selected source-encoding coefficient dataset does not exist in the HDF5 file.
validation_codes.remediation: Choose an existing coefficient dataset.

validation_codes.explanation: The source-encoding coefficients do not use the required non-empty paired real and imaginary layout.
validation_codes.remediation: Use shape (encoded_field_count, source_count, 2), with real then imaginary values on the final axis.

validation_codes.explanation: The source-encoding coefficients are not stored as readable integer or floating-point values.
validation_codes.remediation: Store real and imaginary coefficient parts in a readable real numeric HDF5 dataset; native complex storage is not supported.

validation_codes.explanation: The source-encoding coefficient dataset contains a NaN or infinite value.
validation_codes.remediation: Replace every non-finite coefficient part with a finite value.

validation_codes.explanation: The coefficient dataset source axis does not match the physical source-geometry count.
validation_codes.remediation: Use one coefficient column per physical source point.

validation_codes.explanation: The declared encoded-field count differs from the coefficient dataset's first axis.
validation_codes.remediation: Set count to the dataset's encoded-field count or omit count.

validation_codes.explanation: The optional HDF5 field-name metadata dataset does not exist.
validation_codes.remediation: Choose an existing metadata dataset or omit field_names_dataset.

validation_codes.explanation: The field-name metadata does not contain exactly one value per encoded field.
validation_codes.remediation: Use a one-dimensional dataset whose length matches the encoded-field count.

validation_codes.explanation: The HDF5 field-name metadata cannot be read.
validation_codes.remediation: Provide a readable one-dimensional string dataset.

validation_codes.explanation: A source-encoding field name is empty or is not valid UTF-8 text.
validation_codes.remediation: Store every field name as a non-empty UTF-8 string.

validation_codes.explanation: The HDF5 field-name metadata contains a duplicate name.
validation_codes.remediation: Give every encoded source field a unique name.

validation_codes.explanation: The optional HDF5 reference-coordinate dataset does not exist.
validation_codes.remediation: Choose an existing coordinate dataset or omit reference_coordinates_dataset.

validation_codes.explanation: The HDF5 reference coordinates do not contain one coordinate row per encoded field in the simulation dimension.
validation_codes.remediation: Use shape (encoded_field_count, simulation_dimension).

validation_codes.explanation: The HDF5 reference coordinates are not stored as readable integer or floating-point values.
validation_codes.remediation: Store reference coordinates in a readable real numeric HDF5 dataset.

validation_codes.explanation: The HDF5 reference-coordinate dataset contains a NaN or infinite value.
validation_codes.remediation: Replace every non-finite reference coordinate with a finite value.

validation_codes.explanation: Inline source-field reference coordinates are not numeric.
validation_codes.remediation: Provide a finite numeric coordinate vector in the simulation dimension.

validation_codes.explanation: An opted-in missing absolute file path outside the resolved local project is intended for a target site and cannot be verified locally.
validation_codes.remediation: Confirm that the file exists and is readable on the target site; keep relative and project-local paths available for local validation.

validation_codes.explanation: A model-surface output selection provides neither a name nor a one-based index.
validation_codes.remediation: Specify top, an authored or expanded horizon name, a surface_N alias, or a valid one-based surface index.

validation_codes.explanation: A model-surface output selection has an empty surface name.
validation_codes.remediation: Provide top, an authored or expanded horizon name, or a surface_N alias.

validation_codes.explanation: A model-surface output names a surface that is not visible to the solver.
validation_codes.remediation: Use top, an authored or expanded horizon name, or a one-based surface_N alias; do not use a synthetic bottom alias or borehole name.

validation_codes.explanation: A model-surface output index is not an integer.
validation_codes.remediation: Use a one-based integer surface index.

validation_codes.explanation: A model-surface output index is outside the model's expanded horizon range.
validation_codes.remediation: Use an integer from 1 through the expanded horizon count.

validation_codes.explanation: The simulation names a physics formulation that this FrequenSolve package does not recognize.
validation_codes.remediation: Choose a canonical physics id or alias returned by lookup_physics.

validation_codes.explanation: The simulation dimension cannot be normalized to 2D, 2.5D, or 3D.
validation_codes.remediation: Use 2, 2.5, or 3 and follow any formulation-specific dimension constraints.

validation_codes.explanation: The simulation has no material model attached.
validation_codes.remediation: Attach a supported model before treating the setup as runnable.

validation_codes.explanation: The simulation has no mesh or mesh generator attached.
validation_codes.remediation: Attach a generated or supplied mesh before creating a runnable job.

validation_codes.explanation: The simulation has no acquisition geometry.
validation_codes.remediation: Add at least one supported source geometry and the receivers needed by the workflow.

validation_codes.explanation: The acquisition has no physical source geometry.
validation_codes.remediation: Add an inline, HDF5, or SPS source geometry supported by the current package.

validation_codes.explanation: One or more source, receiver, or output coordinates lie outside the modeled domain.
validation_codes.remediation: Move the coordinates inside the model bounds or intentionally expand the model and mesh.

validation_codes.explanation: Coordinate units cannot be converted to the units used by the model domain.
validation_codes.remediation: Use compatible length units or attach the intended coordinate-system metadata.

validation_codes.explanation: A receiver or output requests a field that is unavailable for the selected physics.
validation_codes.remediation: Choose one of the output components returned by lookup_physics for this formulation.

validation_codes.explanation: The job contains no modeled frequency.
validation_codes.remediation: Provide at least one finite positive frequency.

validation_codes.explanation: A modeled frequency has a real component that is zero or negative.
validation_codes.remediation: Use a frequency with a positive real component.

validation_codes.explanation: A VTK output was requested from a job containing more than one modeled frequency.
validation_codes.remediation: Create one FrequencyDomainJob per plotted frequency.

validation_codes.explanation: A receiver component contains an invalid unit expression.
validation_codes.remediation: Use a valid Pint-compatible unit expression for the receiver component.

validation_codes.explanation: A receiver coordinate file cannot be found at the configured path.
validation_codes.remediation: Correct the file path or create the coordinate file before validation and submission.

validation_codes.explanation: The receiver coordinates use a container type that the package validator cannot interpret.
validation_codes.remediation: Use a supported inline, carpet, grid, or file-backed receiver coordinate representation.

validation_codes.explanation: Receiver coordinates contain an invalid unit expression.
validation_codes.remediation: Use a valid length unit that is compatible with the simulation coordinate system.

validation_codes.explanation: The validator could not read bounds from a receiver coordinate source.
validation_codes.remediation: Check that the coordinate source exists, is readable, and uses the expected supported format.

validation_codes.explanation: A receiver device has no components to record.
validation_codes.remediation: Add at least one named receiver component with a field supported by the selected physics.

validation_codes.explanation: A receiver group has no receiver coordinates.
validation_codes.remediation: Provide supported inline, carpet, grid, or file-backed receiver coordinates.

validation_codes.explanation: A receiver group has no non-empty name.
validation_codes.remediation: Give every receiver group a unique, non-empty name.

validation_codes.explanation: An inline source point has no coordinates.
validation_codes.remediation: Provide one coordinate vector per physical source point.

validation_codes.explanation: An inline source point declares a kind that differs from its containing source geometry.
validation_codes.remediation: Use the same supported source kind for the geometry and every contained source point.

validation_codes.explanation: The source geometry does not declare a source kind.
validation_codes.remediation: Set the source geometry kind to a value supported by the selected physics and source representation.

validation_codes.explanation: The source geometry declares a source kind that FrequenSolve does not support.
validation_codes.remediation: Choose one of the supported source kinds listed in the diagnostic message.

validation_codes.explanation: A dense source-encoding coefficient vector does not match the number of physical sources.
validation_codes.remediation: Provide exactly one coefficient for each physical source point.

validation_codes.explanation: Explicit source encoding contains no encoded fields.
validation_codes.remediation: Add at least one encoded field or remove the explicit encoding block.

validation_codes.explanation: Named source encoding is in use, but one or more inline physical sources have no name.
validation_codes.remediation: Assign a unique explicit name to every inline source referenced by name.

validation_codes.explanation: A source-encoding term references a physical source name that does not exist.
validation_codes.remediation: Correct the term to reference an existing named physical source.

validation_codes.explanation: The acquisition uses a source-encoding type that the package validator does not support.
validation_codes.remediation: Use a supported source-encoding representation or remove the unsupported encoding.

validation_codes.explanation: The source geometry contains an invalid unit expression.
validation_codes.remediation: Use a valid length unit compatible with the simulation coordinate system.

validation_codes.explanation: Inline source geometry is present but contains no physical source points.
validation_codes.remediation: Add at least one physical source point or use another supported source representation.

validation_codes.explanation: Two or more inline source points use the same explicit name.
validation_codes.remediation: Give each named physical source a unique name.

validation_codes.explanation: Coordinate bounds do not have the number of dimensions required by their axes or simulation.
validation_codes.remediation: Provide one lower and upper value for every active model axis.

validation_codes.explanation: Coordinate bounds contain NaN or infinite values.
validation_codes.remediation: Replace every bound with a finite numeric value.

validation_codes.explanation: The lower and upper coordinate bounds have different shapes.
validation_codes.remediation: Provide matching lower and upper bound vectors.

validation_codes.explanation: The generic symmetric condition does not impose full radial-axis regularity at r = 0 for an axisymmetric simulation.
validation_codes.remediation: Use symmetric_r, or the equivalent axis condition, on the x_min boundary at the radial origin.

validation_codes.explanation: A coordinate-system axis maps to an unsupported physical direction.
validation_codes.remediation: Map the axis direction to x, y, or z.

validation_codes.explanation: A coordinate-system axis definition is not a string or Axis object.
validation_codes.remediation: Define each axis with a supported axis name or Axis object.

validation_codes.explanation: A coordinate system declares the same axis name more than once.
validation_codes.remediation: Give every axis in the coordinate system a unique name.

validation_codes.explanation: A coordinate-system axis has no non-empty name.
validation_codes.remediation: Give every coordinate-system axis a non-empty name.

validation_codes.explanation: A coordinate-system axis origin contains an invalid unit expression.
validation_codes.remediation: Use a valid length unit for the axis origin.

validation_codes.explanation: A coordinate system declares a fixed axis without its fixed coordinate value.
validation_codes.remediation: Provide fixed_value or remove fixed_axis.

validation_codes.explanation: A fixed coordinate value contains an invalid unit expression.
validation_codes.remediation: Use a valid length unit for the fixed coordinate value.

validation_codes.explanation: A coordinate system uses a coordinate-system type that the package does not support.
validation_codes.remediation: Choose one of the coordinate-system types listed in the diagnostic message.

validation_codes.explanation: Two registered coordinate systems use the same name.
validation_codes.remediation: Give every registered coordinate system a unique name.

validation_codes.explanation: A registered coordinate system has no non-empty name.
validation_codes.remediation: Give every registered coordinate system a non-empty name.

validation_codes.explanation: A coordinate system declares a dimension other than two or three.
validation_codes.remediation: Set the coordinate-system dimension to 2 or 3.

validation_codes.explanation: A configuration references a coordinate-system name that is not registered on the simulation.
validation_codes.remediation: Register the named coordinate system or correct the reference to an existing system.

validation_codes.explanation: A registered coordinate-system entry is not a CoordinateSystem object.
validation_codes.remediation: Register a valid CoordinateSystem instance.

validation_codes.explanation: Coordinates are not a two-dimensional array of points and coordinate components.
validation_codes.remediation: Provide coordinates shaped as (number of points, model dimension).

validation_codes.explanation: Coordinate points have a different number of components than the simulation model dimension.
validation_codes.remediation: Provide one coordinate component for every active model axis.

validation_codes.explanation: Coordinates could not be converted to numeric values.
validation_codes.remediation: Replace unsupported coordinate values with finite numbers or supported quantities.

validation_codes.explanation: Coordinates contain NaN or infinite values.
validation_codes.remediation: Replace every coordinate component with a finite numeric value.

validation_codes.explanation: A coordinate value contains an invalid unit expression.
validation_codes.remediation: Use a valid length unit compatible with the selected coordinate system.

validation_codes.explanation: A direction references an axis that the selected coordinate system does not expose.
validation_codes.remediation: Choose an axis exposed by the active coordinate system.

validation_codes.explanation: A direction vector contains NaN or infinite values.
validation_codes.remediation: Replace every direction component with a finite numeric value.

validation_codes.explanation: A direction uses a representation type that the package validator does not support.
validation_codes.remediation: Use a supported vector, axis, radial, normal, or other listed direction type.

validation_codes.explanation: A direction contains an invalid unit expression.
validation_codes.remediation: Use a valid unit expression appropriate for the direction value.

validation_codes.explanation: A referenced model-domain id is not an integer.
validation_codes.remediation: Use an integer mesh-block id from a declared model subdomain.

validation_codes.explanation: A referenced model-domain id does not match any declared model subdomain.
validation_codes.remediation: Use one of the known mesh-block ids listed in the diagnostic message.

validation_codes.explanation: A receiver component or output selection has no field name.
validation_codes.remediation: Choose a non-empty field supported by the selected physics.

validation_codes.explanation: A grid uses dimension names that the selected coordinate system does not expose.
validation_codes.remediation: Use only axes exposed by the active coordinate system.

validation_codes.explanation: A grid coordinate axis contains no coordinate values.
validation_codes.remediation: Provide at least one finite value for every grid dimension.

validation_codes.explanation: A grid coordinate axis could not be interpreted as numeric values.
validation_codes.remediation: Use finite numeric coordinate values or supported quantities.

validation_codes.explanation: A named grid dimension has no corresponding coordinate array.
validation_codes.remediation: Provide a coordinate array for every grid dimension.

validation_codes.explanation: A grid coordinate axis contains NaN or infinite values.
validation_codes.remediation: Replace every grid coordinate with a finite numeric value.

validation_codes.explanation: A grid coordinate axis is not strictly increasing or strictly decreasing.
validation_codes.remediation: Sort the axis and remove duplicate coordinate values so it is strictly monotonic.

validation_codes.explanation: A grid coordinate axis contains an invalid unit expression.
validation_codes.remediation: Use a valid length unit compatible with the grid coordinate system.

validation_codes.explanation: A grid has a different number of dimensions than its coordinate system requires.
validation_codes.remediation: Provide one grid dimension and coordinate array for every active axis.

validation_codes.explanation: A grid repeats one or more dimension names.
validation_codes.remediation: Give every grid dimension a unique name.

validation_codes.explanation: An xarray-backed grid has no dimension names.
validation_codes.remediation: Declare the grid dimensions and corresponding coordinate arrays.

validation_codes.explanation: The package validator does not know how to inspect this grid representation.
validation_codes.remediation: Use a supported Cartesian or xarray grid, or validate the custom grid separately.

validation_codes.explanation: A grid contains an invalid default unit expression.
validation_codes.remediation: Use a valid length unit compatible with the grid coordinate system.

validation_codes.explanation: The job has no frequency-list value.
validation_codes.remediation: Provide at least one finite frequency with a positive real component.

validation_codes.explanation: A job frequency cannot be interpreted as a real or complex number.
validation_codes.remediation: Replace the value with a numeric frequency.

validation_codes.explanation: A job frequency contains NaN or an infinite real or imaginary component.
validation_codes.remediation: Use a finite numeric frequency.

validation_codes.explanation: A 2.5D job does not define the signed physical Fourier wavenumbers required by the solver contract.
validation_codes.remediation: Provide a nonempty signed k_list with explicit k_units, then refine the wavenumber grid until the 2.5D result is converged.

validation_codes.explanation: The physical Fourier-wavenumber grid is empty, nested, nonnumeric, or contains a nonfinite value.
validation_codes.remediation: Provide k_list as one nonempty list of finite numeric wavenumbers.

validation_codes.explanation: The optional 2.5D quadrature weights do not have the same number of values as k_list.
validation_codes.remediation: Provide exactly one k_weight per k_list value, or omit k_weights to use the solver contract's trapezoid weights.

validation_codes.explanation: The optional wavenumber quadrature weights are empty, nested, nonnumeric, or contain a nonfinite value.
validation_codes.remediation: Provide k_weights as one nonempty list of finite numeric values, or omit it to use trapezoid weights.

validation_codes.explanation: A job provides 2.5D quadrature weights without the corresponding physical wavenumber grid.
validation_codes.remediation: Provide the matching k_list or remove k_weights.

validation_codes.explanation: The wavenumber unit expression is invalid or cannot be converted to inverse length.
validation_codes.remediation: Use a valid inverse-length unit such as 1/m or 1/km.

validation_codes.explanation: The job output configuration cannot be interpreted as JobOutputs.
validation_codes.remediation: Use supported trace, VTK, or wavefield output configuration objects.

validation_codes.explanation: The job has no simulation attached.
validation_codes.remediation: Attach a configured simulation before validating or submitting the job.

validation_codes.explanation: A file-backed mesh does not declare its file format.
validation_codes.remediation: Set the mesh format to the format used by the supplied mesh file.

validation_codes.explanation: Mesh-generator bounds do not match the simulation model dimension.
validation_codes.remediation: Provide one lower and upper mesh bound for every model axis.

validation_codes.explanation: A mesh generator has only one of its lower and upper bounds.
validation_codes.remediation: Provide both l_bound and u_bound.

validation_codes.explanation: Mesh-generator bounds cannot be interpreted as numeric coordinate vectors.
validation_codes.remediation: Use matching finite numeric lower and upper bound vectors.

validation_codes.explanation: Mesh-generator bounds contain NaN or infinite values.
validation_codes.remediation: Replace every mesh bound with a finite numeric value.

validation_codes.explanation: Mesh-generator lower and upper bounds have different lengths.
validation_codes.remediation: Provide matching lower and upper bound vectors.

validation_codes.explanation: A mesh generator contains an invalid unit expression.
validation_codes.remediation: Use a valid length unit compatible with the simulation model.

validation_codes.explanation: The attached mesh is neither a supported MeshManager nor a supported mesh generator.
validation_codes.remediation: Attach a MeshManager, a supported mesh generator, or a valid file-backed mesh configuration.

validation_codes.explanation: The material model dimension does not match the simulation model dimension.
validation_codes.remediation: Rebuild the model with the spatial dimension required by the simulation.

validation_codes.explanation: A model property uses an invalid coordinate-unit expression.
validation_codes.remediation: Use valid coordinate length units for the model property.

validation_codes.explanation: A model property uses an invalid value-unit expression.
validation_codes.remediation: Use valid physical units appropriate for the model property.

validation_codes.explanation: Two or more model subdomains use the same mesh-block id.
validation_codes.remediation: Give every model subdomain a unique integer mesh-block id.

validation_codes.explanation: A property output was requested, but the model declares no properties that can be checked.
validation_codes.remediation: Attach the intended material model and confirm the requested property names before running.

validation_codes.explanation: An output source id is not a one-based positive integer.
validation_codes.remediation: Use integer source ids starting at 1.

validation_codes.explanation: An output source id is greater than the number of available physical sources.
validation_codes.remediation: Choose a source id within the available one-based source range.

validation_codes.explanation: An output-units mapping contains an empty dimension name.
validation_codes.remediation: Use a non-empty physical-dimension name for every output-units entry.

validation_codes.explanation: An output contains an invalid unit expression.
validation_codes.remediation: Use valid Pint-compatible output unit expressions.

validation_codes.explanation: A VTK item uses an unsupported item kind.
validation_codes.remediation: Use one of the cataloged field, property, or info item kinds.

validation_codes.explanation: A VTK item is not a supported VtkItem or field/property selection.
validation_codes.remediation: Construct the item with the supported VTK output helpers.

validation_codes.explanation: A VTK output has no non-empty name.
validation_codes.remediation: Give every VTK output a non-empty name.

validation_codes.explanation: A wavefield output contains an invalid component-unit expression.
validation_codes.remediation: Use valid physical units for every wavefield component.

validation_codes.explanation: A wavefield output does not define the grid where fields should be sampled.
validation_codes.remediation: Attach a supported sampling grid to the WavefieldOutput.

validation_codes.explanation: A wavefield output has no non-empty name.
validation_codes.remediation: Give every wavefield output a non-empty name.

validation_codes.explanation: A projection references an axis that the selected coordinate system does not expose.
validation_codes.remediation: Choose an axis exposed by the active coordinate system.

validation_codes.explanation: A projection references a component that the selected coordinate system does not expose.
validation_codes.remediation: Choose only components exposed by the active coordinate system.

validation_codes.explanation: The simulation does not declare a dimension.
validation_codes.remediation: Set the simulation dimension to a value supported by the selected physics.

validation_codes.explanation: The simulation has no non-empty name.
validation_codes.remediation: Give the simulation a non-empty name.

validation_codes.explanation: The simulation does not declare a physics formulation.
validation_codes.remediation: Choose a canonical physics id or alias returned by lookup_physics.

validation_codes.explanation: The simulation default or scale units contain an invalid unit expression.
validation_codes.remediation: Use valid Pint-compatible unit expressions for simulation unit defaults and scales.

examples.title: Known-small 2D acoustic quickstart
examples.summary: A two-layer acoustic model with a generated mesh, scalar source, pressure receivers, and a single-frequency VTK request.

examples.title: Saved project and job workflow
examples.summary: Save, reload, inspect, and resubmit concrete FrequenSolve job types through BaseJob and Project helpers.

starter_scenarios.title: Known-small 2D acoustic starter
starter_scenarios.summary: A complete deterministic authoring setup for local validation and first-run guidance without starting a solver.
limitations: This scenario validates authoring and export shape but does not run FrequenSolver.
The teaching mesh and frequency are intentionally small and are not production sizing guidance.
Always use the installed package validators before upload or submission.
Automatic guided setup is initially limited to the known-small 2D acoustic scenario.
Other physics entries support lookup and explanation but not automatic setup generation.

Cataloged material profiles cover the public acoustic, elastic isotropic, and poroelastic isotropic baselines; coupled materials remain domain-specific and em material requirements are not yet cataloged.
Additional solver and discretization fields are contract-dependent and must not be guessed from this catalog.
The catalog does not replace package validation, solver contracts, or Cloud-only authorization and storage checks.
Loading the catalog never runs a solver, calls a Cloud API, or reads customer data.
